The server set is Viewpoint: 99 mods. Use "Sync to server" before joining.
DayZ + Viewpoint Interface is a supported local preset: DayZ remains the inventory and ViewpointUI keeps its HUD, quick loot and scroll/E interaction.
All players and the server must install this exact snapshot; Update/Repair verifies content and replaces divergent files.
Do not update this pack from Steam Workshop; it is pinned to the ultra-locked-v2 release.
All players and the server must install this exact snapshot once (Delete mods -> Install).
Start a new save. This version removes the custom maps Big Bear Lake, Constown, Raven Creek, Greenport, and Rabbit Hash, plus Skateboard, Skill Recovery Journal, and KK's Shelves in 3D.
Spawn Selector was removed. Starting locations now use vanilla spawns or map-provided spawn points.

Directional Melee, PoolPit, The Only Cure+, Immersive Physics & Weather and the 99 CVPI are intentionally excluded from Ultra for stability. Expanded Helicopter Events is Build 41 only and is not included.
They Knew [B42] must load before its 42.19 Fix patch. Do not enable They Knew Continued or other They Knew patches at the same time.
ClassicBows is Build 42.20+ and multiplayer, but has a known arrow duplication bug when reloading; PvP is unreliable.
Simple Suppressors adds firearm muzzle suppressors. Test it with Viewpoint True Ballistics, Recoil & ADS, and Attachments UI.
Undead Survivor adds outfits to zombies and may reduce They Knew hazmat spawn rates.
Zombie Camouflage is a stealth mechanic. Viewpoint Tension may still warn about zombies that cannot see you, and multiplayer requires the mod's own setup steps.
Common Sense adds its own ammo counter. Viewpoint Interface already shows firearm rounds, so disable one if the HUD is cluttered.
Has Been Read may lose map read status after reconnecting on B42.20 multiplayer; this does not affect revealed map areas.
FPS Boost is available in EasyPZ Settings: it applies the Viewpoint floor atlas, lighter True Weathers, blood/ragdoll and vehicle texture limits without removing visual mods.
ZombieBuddy may ask you to approve its JAR on first launch.
credits: All mods belong to their respective authors.

uiSuites.name: Viewpoint UI
uiSuites.description: The full Viewpoint Interface suite already used by the packs: first and third person interactions, the clean Viewpoint HUD, inventory, looting, crafting, building and vehicle screens. This is the default and the most tested option.

uiSuites.name: DayZ UI
uiSuites.tagline: DayZ HUD and inventory for Viewpoint
uiSuites.description: Viewpoint DayZ replaces the interface with a DayZ-style HUD, grid inventory where clothing is storage, character, crafting, building, mechanics and driving screens. Viewpoint Base and ZombieBuddy stay installed, and right-click world interactions stay available. Everyone on the server must use this same suite.

uiSuites.name: DayZ + Viewpoint Interface
uiSuites.description: DayZ's inventory, HUD and screens plus Viewpoint Interface's aim/scroll interaction, quick loot and HUD. DayZ remains the inventory; ViewpointUI keeps its HUD, quick loot and screens. The two mods can be loaded in either order.

uiSuites.name: Tarkov UI
uiSuites.tagline: Project Tarkov HUD, inventory and Viewpoint loot
uiSuites.description: Project Tarkov Framework, Health, HUD and Loot & Inventory, plus Inventory Tetris, the Viewpoint loot bridge and HUD Addons. This changes the HUD and the inventory system together while keeping right-click world interactions. Everyone on the server must use this same suite.

uiSuites.name: Native Zomboid
uiSuites.description: Keeps Project Viewpoint and ZombieBuddy for the camera and gameplay, but removes ViewpointUI, DayZ, Tarkov and every inventory/HUD replacement. Project Zomboid uses its native HUD, inventory and loot windows.
